candidates.claim: Switch sw-ot-01 port GigabitEthernet1/0/13 is an active OT-facing access port assigned to VLAN 30 (the corporate zone VLAN) instead of VLAN 10.
candidates.remediation: Reassign GigabitEthernet1/0/13 to access VLAN 10, or shut the port if it is not an authorized connection.

candidates.claim: The access VLAN of sw-ot-01 interface GigabitEthernet1/0/13 differs from the approved baseline: baseline VLAN 10, current VLAN 30.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the deviation by reverting GigabitEthernet1/0/13 to VLAN 10 or documenting an approved exception.

clarifications.question: rtr-01 has two static default routes with equal definition: 0.0.0.0/0 via 198.51.100.1 (edge) and 0.0.0.0/0 via 10.10.99.1 (fw-01 mgmt interface). Is the second default route through the fw-01 mgmt interface intended? If so, traffic arriving from the Internet at rtr-01 could reach fw-01 on its mgmt interface without passing OUTSIDE_IN; the evidence shows MGMT_IN denies this traffic, but please confirm the routing design.
